facts.fact: FaydaVerse (formerly the National ID Program) has registered more than 51 million citizens, about 37.6% of 135.5 million people (share computed from the held population figure).

ETH.note: Nothing stated on numbers at birth.

facts.fact: The state-owned enterprise FaydaVerse, under Ethiopian Investment Holdings, runs the national digital ID system and bills banks for record retrievals and authentications.

ETH.note: Only banks, private users, are named; no public register keyed on the ID.

facts.fact: Fayda has registered more than 51 million citizens, issued nearly 14 million printed cards and integrated about 150 institutions, each person assigned a unique identification number (Addis Fortune).
